t.zh: 手动喂了几次模型以后，这一章开始搭机器。机器每次运行这块板一次：左边是它拿到的东西，右边是结果去的地方，中间由你接。
t.en: After feeding the model by hand, this chapter starts on the machine. It runs this board once: on the left what it is given, on the right where the results go; the middle is yours to wire.

t.zh: 这一章的模型只会被调用一次，不能回头要东西：它看到什么就写什么。这一关的 issue 自带了代码。
t.en: In this chapter the model is called once and cannot ask for anything: it writes from what it sees. This level’s issues come with their code.

showcase.zh: 第一块板：机器跑一遍板，左边是它拿到的，右边是结果去的地方，中间由玩家接；模型本身在纸笔一章里已经亲手调用过
showcase.en: the first board: the machine runs it once, what it is given on the left, where the results go on the right, the middle wired by the player; the model itself was called by hand in Pen and paper

after.zh: issue 里贴了代码，模型就看得到要改的函数，一次写对。板上线里流的是上下文：一组条目，每条占一些 token；模型读进一段上下文，给出一个动作。
after.en: With the code pasted into the issue, the model can see the function to change and writes it right in one go. What runs on these wires is context: a list of entries, each taking some tokens; the model reads a context and gives one action.

brief.zh: 搭一块板：把 issue 交给模型，它写出的修改落进仓库。
brief.en: Build a board: hand the issue to the model, and what it writes lands in the repository.

hint.zh: 从 issue 右边的圆点连到模型，再从模型连到仓库。
hint.en: Wire the dot on the right of the issue to the model, and the model to the repository.
